subject: RTW: Low-heat workstation and rotating coverage agreement for Mina Haddad
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary low-heat workstation + schedule limits after knee surgery

Hi Dylan / Monica,

Quick note to flag an accommodation request following my arthroscopic knee procedure last week. The surgeon recommends avoiding prolonged standing and exposure to high ambient temperatures while the incision area heals — I've also become unintentionally heat-sensitive from the meds. My normal schedule includes two late-night on-call rotations per month and a recurring onsite 10pm–2am shift which I think could aggravate recovery.

What I am requesting:
- A low-heat (air-conditioned) workstation for the next 6 weeks when I am onsite.
- Swap out my night/overnight assignments with other engineers when feasible (I can take extra day-shifts instead).
- Flex to work from home on Wednesdays for the first month to reduce commute strain.

I've attached the surgeon's brief note (doctor_note_knee_op.pdf) — it recommends light duty for 4–6 weeks, then a reassessment. Happy to discuss a concrete cover matrix; Evan Price from ShiftCover can help with temporary swaps if that makes ops easier.

Thanks for the quick read — I don't want to jeopardize product launches, just need a short-term accommodation.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior ML Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: doctor_note_knee_op.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Price <evan.price@shiftcover.co>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary low-heat workstation + schedule limits after knee surgery

Mina — thanks for the heads up and the note. Appreciate the early flag.

High level: sounds reasonable and we should enable this without impacting the team's commitments. Proposed immediate steps:
1) Monica / HR to confirm policy and duration.
2) Ops to publish a temporary coverage matrix and propose shift swaps for the upcoming two on-call rotations (I asked Evan to help draft this).
3) Facilities to put you on a low-heat desk near building HVAC intake — Facilities: please prioritize.

I've started a quick coverage spreadsheet and attached a draft (coverage_matrix.xlsx). It proposes that Mina takes two daytime blocks (8am–4pm) in exchange for swapping the 10pm–2am shifts with Rohan and Karthik for the next six weeks. If that works for the team, we can make swaps official and adjust on-call calendars.

Monica — can HR confirm whether the 4–6 week window is sufficient or whether we need an occupational health verification to set a definitive end-date? Also let me know if we need a formal accommodation form signed.

Mina — if you're ok with the draft matrix, I'll push it to the team's calendar and notify Rohan/Karthik.

Thanks,
Dylan
Director, ML Platform
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: coverage_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthPartners Occupational Health <occ-services@healthpartners.org>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2026 13:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary low-heat workstation + schedule limits after knee surgery

Hi all,

Thanks — HR has reviewed Mina's surgeon note. We can approve a time-limited duty modification for six weeks effective Oct 4–Nov 15 with the following conditions:

- Facilities will assign a low-heat workstation and mark it reserved for Mina on days she is onsite.
- Night rotations will be swapped per the attached coverage matrix; Dylan, please confirm that Rohan/Karthik can be notified and their calendars updated.
- Mina will work remotely on Wednesdays for the first four weeks.
- Occupational Health (cc'd) to provide an optional follow-up check at week 4 if any extension beyond Nov 15 is requested. The requesters should route any extensions through occ-services for an updated fit-for-duty note.

Operational notes:
- This is an interim accommodation — it is not a change to role expectations beyond the dates above.
- We need Mina to sign a short acknowledgment confirming she understands the temporary nature and will return to standard scheduling unless HR approves an extension.

Evan / Facilities: please confirm the low-heat desk assignment and update the shared Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1RtW-accom-plan-2026.

Mina — I can draft the acknowledgment; once you approve, sign and return the PDF and I'll add it to your HR file.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
People Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: (none inline)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary low-heat workstation + schedule limits after knee surgery

Thanks both — I reviewed the coverage matrix and Monica's note and everything looks good. Two quick clarifications:

- If Rohan/Karthik need an extra incentive for the swap (e.g., time-bank hours), I'm happy to reimburse time-bank points for the swapped nights rather than ask them to take unpaid changes.
- I'll plan to check in with Occupational Health at week 4, as suggested.

I've signed the acknowledgment and attached it here (signed-accommodation-acknowledgment.pdf). Appreciate the fast turnaround — I should be fully back to normal scheduling after Nov 15 barring any complications.

Best,
Mina
Senior ML Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
